description: Get an owner group's ownership details: label and consumer wording, owner or PE backers and since when, PE stake (majority or minority), how it holds practices (buyout, partnership, joint venture, de novo), parent and brands, every source with its headline and date, and known locations by state. Covers questions like "who owns Heartland Dental?" or "is Aspen Dental private equity?" (brand names work). Also answers for consumer brands ("Orvis") and for the companies and PE firms behind them ("Authentic Brands Group", "Sycamore Partners"): the brands on our list they own or back.

id.description: Group id from another result, e.g. "dental:heartland-dental".

industry.description: dental, eye (optometry, ophthalmology, optical), vet, derm, gi, or brand (a consumer brand). Leave out to infer it from the name.

name.description: Group, brand, company or PE firm name, e.g. "Heartland Dental", "MyEyeDr", "Orvis", "Sycamore Partners".

name: get_group
title: Who owns or backs this group?
